SELECT t_delivery_place_class.id, t_delivery_place_class.`status`, t_delivery_place_class.delivery_place_class_no AS deliveryPlaceClassNo, t_delivery_place_class.delivery_place_class_name AS deliveryPlaceClassName, t_delivery_place_class.delivery_place_class_orders AS deliveryPlaceClassOrders, t_delivery_place_class.org_no AS orgNo, t_delivery_place_class.org_name AS orgName, t_delivery_place_class.dept_no AS deptNo, t_delivery_place_class.dept_name AS deptName FROM t_delivery_place_class WHERE t_delivery_place_class.is_deleted = #{param.deleted}
AND t_delivery_place_class.`status` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.status}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place_class.delivery_place_class_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deliveryPlaceClassNo}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place_class.delivery_place_class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deliveryPlaceClassName}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place_class.delivery_place_class_orders LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deliveryPlaceClassOrders}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place_class.org_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.orgNo}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place_class.org_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.orgName}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place_class.dept_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deptNo}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place_class.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deptName}, '%')
ORDER BY t_delivery_place_class.delivery_place_class_orders ASC
